title: Ask the agent to review the board
done: That is it: Review stays lit until the agent has read the board.

steps.caption: While you draw, Editing is ticked: it tells the agent you are still changing the board.
When you are done, Review asks the agent to read the board now. It ends Editing, and sends your questions.
Review stays lit until the agent has read it.
Here the agent has read it, and Review turns off.
